metadata.title: Business metrics every dashboard needs
metadata.subtitle: Each row is a definition, not just a formula.

dataPoints.meaning: Total money received over a period
dataPoints.watch_out: Returns and refunds should be netted before reporting.
Skewed by a few large orders — report median alongside mean.

dataPoints.meaning: Share of each revenue dollar that survives COGS
dataPoints.watch_out: Cost allocation choices change the answer; document them.

dataPoints.meaning: Share of visits that produced a purchase
dataPoints.watch_out: Definition of 'qualifying visitor' is everything. Bots are not customers.

dataPoints.meaning: Share of the base that left this month
dataPoints.watch_out: 'Churn' needs a behavioral definition — 'no purchase for 60 days' is a choice.

dataPoints.meaning: Share of customers who returned at least once
dataPoints.watch_out: The window matters: 30 days, 90 days, or lifetime tell different stories.

dataPoints.meaning: Average value of an active customer in the period
dataPoints.watch_out: Defining 'active' as 'any purchase' inflates the denominator with one-time buyers.

dataPoints.meaning: Forecast of total revenue from a customer over their tenure
dataPoints.watch_out: All three inputs are estimates with their own error — report a range, not a point.
Boundary of 'category' is editorial — be explicit about it.
